description:
This luxurious two-bedroom apartment is pet friendly and situated on the 10th floor, designed to provide the best living experience possible. It has a generously sized open-plan living space with floor-to-ceiling windows, plus two double bedrooms with a built-in wardrobe. A high-quality kitchen with integrated appliances makes dinner time easy and there’s plenty of storage space. The apartment is furnished with private parking spaces available for an additional fee (POA). There is also secure bike storage with a workshop for bike maintenance.

 We like to practice what we preach, so we’ve made ourselves accountable in setting a new standard for renting. Way of Life is a voluntary member of governing bodies that hold us to strict codes in property, service and the protection of tenancy deposits, and our online tenancy management system is available 24/7 for ultimate peace of mind. No unexpected fees. No troublesome small print. Just leases that are straightforward and easy to manage.

ABOUT THE LANSDOWNE

The bright, double-height lobby gives way to a series of smart workspaces and lounges across two levels. The ground floor workspace is a far cry from staid corporate office. Pull up a pew at a communal desk or sink into an armchair in the library-like green room for a laptop session away from the buzz.

 Only a 5 minute walk to FiveWays Train station and 3 minute walk to FiveWays Tram station, this building offers a spacious, air-conditioned gym on the lower ground floor, which is stocked with state-of-the-art Technogym equipment, including distinctive weight and cardio zones. A secure bike storage area nearby includes a workshop for on-the-go maintenance and a table tennis table.

An airy, flexible space for co-working, events and good conversation, the cultural mixer is The Lansdowne’s central hub. Choose a cubicle for ultimate privacy when you’re plugged in or settle in with a book or laptop by the window. Ideal for birthdays or gatherings that require a little extra fanfare, there’s a fully equipped kitchen at the far end and a solid oak dining table to seat up to 18.For cosy catch ups with the neighbours, The Den is a sophisticated hangout space with a wall-mounted television, pool table and a stack of board games.

AREA GUIDE

From lazy evenings in effortlessly chic wine bars, to the constant buzz of a cultural quarter that pulls no punches, there’s nowhere else quite like the UK’s second city.

TO DO

Where do we start with Birmingham? One of the UK’s largest cities, it has its own unique character and is a multicultural hub for creativity, independent eateries , bars and shops in the heart of the Midlands. You’ll find hidden gems throughout the city, however let’s start local to The Lansdowne with Edgbaston and the fantastic local places to eat including the newly opened Smoke and Ash Pizzeria, which offers the finest Italian cuisine and some great experimental cocktails. Chapter restaurant offers delicious breakfast through to dinner menus, whilst Loki Wines has an amazing choice of wines and bottled beers, which can be enjoyed on their terrace. For some good old fashioned grub, you can head to The High Field or The Physician. However, if you fancy a touch of luxury why not head to the Michelin star restaurant, Simpson.  

Edgbaston Village is also home to luxury interior specialists; there are a whole host of home and lifestyle stores in the area, including Neptune, BoConcept and many others. And if you’re a fan of the active and outdoorsy lifestyle, visit Birmingham botanical gardens located only a short walk away from The Lansdowne, a truly beautiful green space featuring and wonderful glass houses.
